features.name: Amphibious
features.description: You can breathe air and water, and have a swimming speed equal to your walking speed.

features.name: Tongue
features.description: You have a tongue that you can use to make unarmed strikes. When you hit with them, the strike deals 1d6 + your Strength modifier bludgeoning damage, instead of the normal for an unarmed strike. In addition, when you make a melee attack using your tongue on your turn, your reach for it is 5 feet greater than normal.

features.name: Swamp Camouflage
features.description: You have advantage on a Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in swamp-like terrain. Additionally, you ignore nonmagical difficult terrain caused by mud, shallow water, and swamp terrain.

conditionalAdvantage.note: VTT should resolve the feature-specific predicate using the named rule hook if direct support is unavailable.

features.name: Standing Leap
features.description: Your base long jump and high jump is equal to your speed, with or without a running start.
